scope: registered file transformations only; exact recovery snapshot, not bulk-deploy authorization

entries.content:
# OpenHAB Icon Map File
# These icon definitions are intended to display well on a black background.
# Moon Phase Icons (using Material Design Icons - better for dark backgrounds)
NEW=iconify:mdi:moon-new
FIRST_QUARTER=iconify:mdi:moon-first-quarter
WAXING_CRESCENT=iconify:mdi:moon-waxing-crescent
WAXING_GIBBOUS=iconify:mdi:moon-waxing-gibbous
FULL=iconify:mdi:moon-full
WANING_GIBBOUS=iconify:mdi:moon-waning-gibbous
THIRD_QUARTER=iconify:mdi:moon-last-quarter
WANING_CRESCENT=iconify:mdi:moon-waning-crescent

# Sunrise and Sunset Icons (Material Design Icons)
CIVIL_DAWN=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
ASTRO_DAWN=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
NAUTIC_DAWN=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
SUN_RISE=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
SUN_SET=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down
CIVIL_DUSK=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down
NAUTIC_DUSK=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down
ASTRO_DUSK=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down

# Daytime Icons
DAYLIGHT=iconify:mdi:white-balance-sunny
NOON=iconify:mdi:white-balance-sunny

# Night Icons (added 2026-07-11 — NIGHT was unmapped, ~1240 warns/day)
NIGHT=iconify:mdi:weather-night
MORNING_NIGHT=iconify:mdi:weather-night
EVENING_NIGHT=iconify:mdi:weather-night

NEW=iconify:emojione-monotone:new-moon-face
FIRST_QUARTER=iconify:emojione-monotone:first-quarter-moon
WAXING_CRESCENT=iconify:emojione-monotone:waxing-crescent-moon
WAXING_GIBBOUS=iconify:emojione-monotone:waxing-gibbous-moon
FULL=iconify:emojione-monotone:full-moon-face
WANING_GIBBOUS=iconify:emojione-monotone:waning-gibbous-moon
THIRD_QUARTER=iconify:emojione-monotone:last-quarter-moon
WANING_CRESCENT=iconify:emojione-monotone:waning-crescent-moon

CIVIL_DAWN=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
ASTRO_DAWN=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
NAUTIC_DAWN=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
SUN_RISE=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-up
SUN_SET=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down
CIVIL_DUSK=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down
NAUTIC_DUSK=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down
ASTRO_DUSK=iconify:mdi:weather-sunset-down
DAYLIGHT=iconify:mdi:white-balance-sunny
NOON=iconify:mdi:white-balance-sunny

NULL=iconify:bx:bx-error
